acceptance.given: A disposable package contains a required direct first-level local reference configured in turn with a missing file, missing anchor, traversal path, absolute path, or an actually supported symlink/junction escaping the package root; a sentinel outside the package makes attempted reads observable.

oracle.expected: During validation, each invalid reference is rejected with the corresponding structured path or boundary diagnostic before any operation reads the outside sentinel; the symlink case executes in an environment that supports the link type under test.
forbidden: Any invalid reference is accepted or validation continues as if required local content were present.
An outside-package content read occurs before rejection.
An unsupported symlink environment is reported as a passing containment check.
oracle.observable: Invoke the real validate_package entry against disposable package variants and instrument or otherwise observe the forbidden content-read operation; assert rejection status and diagnostic for each variant, and assert zero outside-sentinel reads.

acceptance.then: Every invalid reference is rejected before any package-external content read, with diagnostics identifying the rejected reference or containment failure.
acceptance.when: When validating direct first-level local references, inspect validation outcomes and the outside-read sentinel at the time each reference is resolved, before accepting the package.
